purpose: Nghiệm thu user-web trước khi chuyển sang admin-web

environment.email_and_gemini: Mocked for deterministic GUI regression; real SMTP/Gemini validation will be recorded separately with approved synthetic data.
environment.note: Production standalone build via isolated fault proxy; browser tabs use separate sessionStorage. Source edits by other tools paused.
environment.status: Final QA completed. Historical environment retained; closure contains the final test environment.

measurement.denominator: All required GUI cases below; unit/API assertions are reported separately and never added to the GUI numerator.
measurement.gui_completion: (passed + failed) / required; blocked and not_run are not executed.
measurement.gui_pass_coverage: passed / required; this is test coverage, not an estimate that all possible defects are absent.
measurement.executed_pass_rate: passed / (passed + failed), only reported alongside completion.
measurement.closure: Every required GUI case passed in the final regression, no blocked/not_run/failed cases; lint, typecheck, build and regression suites pass; no unresolved blocking defects.
measurement.evidence_policy: Every passed GUI case requires dated direct browser observation or recorded user handoff; source inspection, API-only tests and mocks alone do not pass a GUI case.
